title: MLZ bootstrap
description: The one-time setup of the customer's pipelines, run by Fortytwo with mlz-core's bootstrap.

github.description: The customer's GitHub organization, repos, platform team, reviewers and private runner.

platform_team.description: The slug of the GitHub team that owns the three repos: their CODEOWNERS name it, and its approval is required for every change but the contracts.

reviewers.description: GitHub users who approve every apply.

runner_size.description: The private runner's machine size at GitHub, for mlz install runners.

state_operators.description: People who may run Terraform by hand against the state, by name: their Entra object IDs.

names.description: The bootstrap's own name for its resource group or state account, instead of the customer's template's (docs/naming.md): for a storage account name taken elsewhere in Azure, or one to keep.
